messages:
Maria: Hey team — Greenline (prospect) pushed the security/privacy review up. They want CAIQ answers, our DPA with SCCs, and a clear DSAR/deletion runbook before we start the POC. Also asking how POC data will be handled. Can SE/security/legal confirm what artifacts we can hand off today? cc @Ben @Sophie @Max

Ben: I'll grab the CAIQ CSV and our compliance pack. Quick checklist I can populate: self-attested CAIQ, latest pen-test summary (12mo), SOC2 summary, list of subprocessors, KMS/HSM description, DPA + SCCs addendum, and a POC runbook that calls out data handling and retention. ETA to upload: EOD today. For the POC: prefer synthetic data; if they want prod data we should offer Dedicated or Private deployment. @Jordan heads-up on pricing/terms.

SigBot: CAIQ draft uploaded to drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/greenline/CAIQ-draft.xlsx :white_check_mark: (partial answers for infra controls left for Max)

Sophie: On DPA & SCCs: use our standard template; we include EU SCCs (2021) as the transfer mechanism and offer to sign the addendum. Deletion/DSAR commitments we normally state: respond to DSARs within 30 days, deletion completed within 30 days after contract termination unless customer requests an accelerated SLA. Suggested privacy policy blurb for the sales packet: "We process customer prompts and related metadata to provide the service; customers can configure retention settings or request deletion via support. We do not use customer data to train models without explicit consent."

Max: Security highlights to surface: per-customer key support (KMS/HSM), network isolation options (VPC / on-prem), SOC2 scope, last pentest summary, and configurable logging/retention. Important for the POC: default KV cache avoids caching PII — we can disable prefix caching for tenant. Example minimal POC config we can include:
```
retention_days: 30
pii_masking: true
kv_cache_enabled: false
private_deploy: false  # set true if they require tenancy isolation
```
Also recommend we provide the pen-test executive summary rather than full report for initial review.

Jordan: I'll draft a 2-week POC runbook: week 0: kickoff + connectivity, week 1: ingest & functional tests, week 2: scale/latency/quality checks + handoff. If they need Dedicated for prod testing, note that Dedicated requires a minimum 3-month commitment (pricing team will provide numbers). For hosted POC with strict retention we can do a short trial but call out retention and DSAR handling in the SOW.

Ben: Two small notes: 1) SCCs — we can sign the EU SCCs annex and provide an EU data processing addendum; legal needs to sign. 2) For the CAIQ, I'll flag any 'partial' controls and add remediation notes. I'll also attach a sample DPA (redacted) and an example SOW with retention language.

Maria: Great — thanks everyone. Plan: Ben uploads artifacts to the Greenline folder and pings me, Sophie to confirm DPA wording, Max to fill remaining CAIQ infra controls, Jordan to finalize POC runbook. I'll schedule a 30-min handoff with Greenline for Thu 10am PT once artifacts are uploaded. :calendar:

Maria: If anyone has a short snippet we can drop into procurement packet right now (e.g., deletion SLA + contact flow), paste it here and I'll add it to the email to their procurement team.
